rows.title: The germinal products overview page, with packages and kilograms commodity totals
rows.detail: A trader filling in a germinal products notification needs an overview of their own notification, so they can see its reference and status, what is left to do and where to go next. The germinal set gets its own overview page, keyed by the notification just as the live animals overview is, carrying the same heading, status, numbered task list and end buttons. Germinal products are counted by packages and by weight rather than by head of animal, so the commodity totals block shows a packages card and a kilograms card instead of the animals card, and the kilograms card totals the gross weight entered for the consignment and rounds it the same way wherever that total is shown. Screen-reader users get the same named regions as on the live animals overview, with the weight card named for the gross weight the set holds. The live animals overview keeps the cards it shows today.
acceptanceCriteria: A germinal products notification has an overview page of its own in the germinal products set, keyed by that notification as the live animals overview is, reached from the dashboard's link to that notification, showing the heading 'Overview', the notification's status and reference, the numbered task list, and the buttons 'Review and submit' then 'Return to dashboard' (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-006, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-008, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-009, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-011, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-012, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-014; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-056; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p5-001, repo-frontend-p5-055, repo-frontend-p5-061; trace:animals-fit trace-animals-fit-p4-001; c-128)

A germinal products notification's overview has the browser page title 'Overview - Import notification service - GOV.UK' (trace:animals-fit trace-animals-fit-p4-002; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p5-001)

On a germinal products notification's overview, 'Your commodities' shows a card labelled 'Packages/boxes' and a card labelled 'Kilograms' whose caption reads 'Total weight of packages in this consignment' (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-013; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p12-147)

On a germinal products notification's overview, 'Your commodities' shows exactly two cards: 'Packages/boxes' and 'Kilograms' (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-013; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-022, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-023)
The 'Kilograms' card reads '0' before any gross weight is entered, and whenever the total gross weight is not a positive number (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-016)

The 'Kilograms' card totals the gross weight in kilograms entered for the consignment, showing a whole-number total as entered, for example '12' for 5 and 7, and any other total rounded to 3 decimal places, for example '2.5' for 1.25 and 1.25 (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-016; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-022; c-022)

On a germinal products notification's overview, the 'Packages/boxes' card is a region named 'Packages summary' and the 'Kilograms' card is a region named 'Gross weight summary' (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-013; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p11-013-m1; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-022; c-244)

On a germinal products notification's overview, the 'Your commodities' block, the task list and each numbered task section are regions named by their own heading (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p11-013-m1; prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-013; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p5-017)
A live animals notification's overview shows exactly two cards: 'Animals' and 'Packages/boxes' (trace:animals-fit trace-animals-fit-p4-008)

A germinal products notification's overview has no serious or critical WCAG 2.2 A or AA accessibility violations, both with the totals at zero and with packages and gross weights entered (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p5-062)
rows.notes: Combines four slices that are one page copy: the germinal overview page itself (req-1836), its swapped commodity cards (req-788), the rule for displaying the gross weight total (req-789) and the card and block regions (req-1837). Building the cards or the regions apart would copy the same page twice and repeat the same set-up, review and ladder. existingRow inc-099 already carries all four alongside req-1763, the germinal Commodity details completeness rule from the commodities area; the combiner should keep inc-099's id, its germinal-products theme, its dependencies on inc-017 and inc-177, and merge this draft with the commodities area's draft for the row, removing repeats. c-128 ruled by precedence: each set keeps a per-notification overview in its own path shape, and the prototype's one session-scoped hub address is set aside, so no criterion here names a path. c-022 ruled: the weight the germinal set holds is a total gross weight in kilograms, as a decimal; prototype-dr2-1-source-p3-031's netWeight storage claim is withdrawn and is named nowhere here. c-244 ruled: the weight card's region is named 'Gross weight summary' while its visible label stays 'Kilograms'. The live animals criterion is a regression check on a page this row does not change. The page is copied from the live animals overview after this programme has changed it, which is why the germinal-products theme lands after overview-and-review.

rows.title: The germinal products overview's Addresses section and its consignment addresses task
rows.detail: A trader filling in a germinal products notification needs the overview to tell them what is left to do for the addresses of the consignment. The germinal set asks only for the five consignment addresses, because it holds no county parish holding number and no permanent address for an animal, so its addresses section holds a single task with the same wording and hint as the live animals overview, and that task is complete as soon as the five consignment addresses are given.
acceptanceCriteria: On a germinal products notification's overview, the fifth section heading reads '5. Addresses' (ruling:sam-2026-11-17 ruling-sam-2026-11-17-p1-010, ruling-sam-2026-11-17-p1-015; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p5-016; c-405)

On a germinal products notification's overview, the 'Addresses' section holds one task, titled 'Consignment addresses' (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-034; ruling:sam-2026-11-17 ruling-sam-2026-11-17-p1-009, ruling-sam-2026-11-17-p1-012; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p5-031; c-405)

The 'Consignment addresses' task on a germinal products notification's overview shows the hint 'Consignor or Exporter, Consignee, Importer and Place of Destination' under its link (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-035; ruling:sam-2026-11-17 ruling-sam-2026-11-17-p1-016; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p12-152; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p5-032)

On a germinal products notification's overview, the 'Consignment addresses' task reads 'Complete' once all five consignment addresses are given, and 'To do' while any of them is missing, with no county parish holding number and no permanent address asked for (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-034; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-017, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-018; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p5-053)

rows.notes: One slice: the germinal overview's own view of the consignment addresses task. Its completion rule can only be observed once the germinal addresses page and its party pickers exist, which is why existingRow inc-181 is the right home: that row builds the copied page this task reads, so building these criteria apart would copy the page twice. The combiner should keep inc-181's id, its germinal-products theme, its dependencies and its external dependencies on the consignment-parties and identification-and-permanent-address splits, and merge this draft into it, removing the repeats its own criteria 2 and 9 make. Rewritten on this re-distil for c-405: the owner's 17 November decision ranks above the prototype, so the section heading reads '5. Addresses' and the task reads 'Consignment addresses'. The prototype's 'Consignment parties' and 'Roles and addresses' names are set aside and appear nowhere here, while prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-034 still backs there being one numbered section holding a single task for the consignment addresses, and the task's hint stays as the prototype gives it. The task covers the consignment addresses only because the germinal set holds no county parish holding number and no permanent address, so the live rule that keeps the task short of complete until every addressable animal has a permanent address does not apply here. Templates are parked, so the template renumbering of the section is not built.

rows.title: The germinal products overview's transit countries task
rows.detail: A trader importing germinal products through another country needs to see the transit countries task on their overview, so they know it is outstanding. The task sits in the transport and arrival section between arrival details and transport details whenever transit countries are required for the notification, is absent when they are not, and reads complete once a transit country is chosen. What makes transit countries required for a notification is decided with the arrival and transit pages; this row is the overview's view of it.
acceptanceCriteria: When transit countries are required for a germinal products notification, its overview's '3. Transport and arrival' section lists 'Arrival details', then 'Transit countries', then 'Transport details' (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-030; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p12-150; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p5-016, repo-frontend-p5-021)

When transit countries are not required for a germinal products notification, its overview's '3. Transport and arrival' section lists 'Arrival details', then 'Transport details' (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-030; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-057; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p5-039, repo-frontend-p5-040)

Where it is shown, a germinal products notification's 'Transit countries' task reads 'To do' until at least one transit country is selected, and 'Complete' once one is (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-030; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-014; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p5-029, repo-frontend-p5-035)

sources.ref: repo-frontend-p5-016, -p5-021, -p5-029, -p5-035, -p5-039, -p5-040 (the live-animals hub sections and conditional task rows)

rows.notes: One slice: the germinal half of the overview's transit countries task, split from its live animals half by the 9 October decision. The rule that decides when transit countries are required belongs with the arrival and transit pages, and the task needs the germinal set's own transit countries page, so this row cannot be observed before that page exists. existingRow inc-182 is the right home: that row builds the germinal arrival and transit countries pages these criteria read. The combiner should keep inc-182's id, its germinal-products theme, its dependencies and its external dependencies, and merge this draft into it, removing repeats. Criterion 2 states the order the section shows rather than what it leaves out, so a reviewer checks a positive order.
